"""Preserve only files generated by the failed browser run; no fixture inputs."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

ROOT = Path(__file__).absolute().parents[2]
RUN = Path(__file__).absolute().parent
SOURCE = ROOT / 'tmp/coord-w14-final-20261022/report/w14-react-evidence/final-main-2026-10-22-run3'
TARGET = RUN / 'browser-red-before-sa54'
end = (RUN / 'browser-exit.json').stat().st_mtime
record = json.loads((RUN / 'browser-exit.json').read_text())
assert record['native_exit_code'] == 1
start = end - record['elapsed_seconds'] - 5
TARGET.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows = []
for path in SOURCE.iterdir():
    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {'.json', '.png', '.webm', '.log'}:
        continue
    if path.stat().st_mtime < start:
        continue
    data = path.read_bytes()
    target = TARGET / path.name
    assert not target.exists()
    shutil.copyfile(path, target)
    assert hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).digest() == hashlib.sha256(data).digest()
    rows.append({'path': path.name, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
assert 'browser-audit.json' in [row['path'] for row in rows]
assert 'runtime.json' in [row['path'] for row in rows]
(TARGET / 'archive-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'native_exit': record, 'files': rows}, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'archived_files': len(rows), 'excluded_fixture_inputs': True, 'native_exit': 1}))
